MfaSetup.Title: Setup Authenticator
MfaSetup.SubTitle: Protect your account with two-step security.
MfaSetup.step1: Download Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator on your phone.
MfaSetup.step2: Open the app and select the '+' icon to add a new account.
MfaSetup.step3: Select 'Scan QR code' and focus on the image to the right.
MfaSetup.step4: Enter the 6-digit code displayed on your phone to verify the link.
